name: Pelican
overview: The pelican is mentioned in the Old Testament as one of the birds listed among those considered unclean, as seen in Leviticus 11:18 and Deuteronomy 14:17. In Psalms 102:6, the pelican is used metaphorically to express loneliness and desolation, likening the psalmist to a pelican of the wilderness. These references highlight the pelican's symbolic association with isolation and wilderness in Scripture.
